name: Aruna Yekkala
headline: Clinic Director
about:
As a highly-motivated and service-oriented professional, I have a proven record of success in administrating healthcare facility operations and processing disability/ leave of absence claims. I demonstrated exceptional capabilities in investigating and processing medical/non-medical accommodation requests. My expertise includes interviewing, compiling, disseminating, and evaluating the information, paired with a knack for coordinating with claimants, managers, HR, workers' compensation, and legal teams to identify leaves and return to work opportunities for occupational/non-occupational injuries/illnesses/conditions. I am skilled in encouraging cross-functional collaboration, resulting in optimal productivity and client satisfaction. As a meticulous leader, I am seeking to strengthen overall healthcare administration by maintaining transparency and effective supervision.

experiences.description:
As the Clinic Director at Assure Physio & Rehab, I am dedicated to leading a multidisciplinary team that prioritizes patient-centered care, clinical excellence, and long-term recovery outcomes. With a strong background in physiotherapy and healthcare leadership, I bring a hands-on approach to both clinical operations and team development.
At Assure Physio & Rehab, we believe that effective rehabilitation is built on trust, education, and individualized treatment plans. My role involves overseeing daily clinic operations, implementing evidence-based practices, and ensuring a supportive, results-driven environment for both patients and staff.
With a passion for helping individuals regain function and improve quality of life, I focus on aligning our services with each client’s unique goals—whether they’re recovering from injury, managing chronic pain, or optimizing their physical performance.
I’m always open to connecting with fellow healthcare professionals, community partners, and those interested in collaborative, holistic approaches to rehabilitation.

•	Decreased financial discrepancies by managing budgeting, expense planning, billing/invoicing, and collection
•	Implemented controls and tasks delegation, monitored time-in/out, leaves, and overtime to process payroll accurately 
•	Performed credentialing and followed up licensure compliance maintenance and timely disseminated information to clinicians regarding license updates requirements
